{{Quote|The Shadow Syndicate is at your command. Along with Imperial Intelligence, we're here to support your campaign against the Republic.|Narvusin, to an Imperial operative|<ref name="TOR:StP" />}}
'''Narvusin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|Male]] [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] who worked for [[Godoba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] of the [[Shadow Syndicate/Legends|Shadow Syndicate]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the war, the Shadow Syndicate allied itself with the Sith Empire and Narvusin served as liaison between Godoba the Hutt and Imperial forces.<ref name="TOR:StP" />
